stock.description: Guotai Junan Securities Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive financial services provider delivering a broad spectrum of offerings to both individual and institutional clients across mainland China, Hong Kong, and internationally. Its operations are structured across distinct divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Banking, Institutional and Trading, Investment Management, and International Business. The firm furnishes services such as securities and futures brokerage, bespoke financial products, expert investment advice, and diverse financing avenues including margin lending, securities repurchase, and stock collateralization. Its investment banking division specializes in listing sponsorship, underwriting equity and debt, facilitating structured debt financing, offering M&A advisory, and developing tailored corporate solutions for both businesses and governmental entities. For institutional clientele, it provides brokerage, trading, and equity investment services, alongside seat leasing, custody, outsourcing, and Qualified Foreign Institutional Investor (QFII) support. The company actively engages in investment transactions spanning equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, and commodities, leveraging derivative instruments to craft comprehensive solutions for clients' investment, funding, and risk mitigation needs. It also extends asset and fund management services. Globally, its offerings encompass brokerage, corporate finance, asset management, lending, financial product distribution, market making, and investment activities. Additionally, the company has interests in real estate and property management, warehousing, corporate consulting, venture capital, industrial investment, and broader investment consulting. Established in 1992, the firm maintains its headquarters in Shanghai, China.

moat.method: AI qualitative assessment anchored to dated financial statements and available transcript; not a reported accounting measure

provenance.ebitda: Analyst ebitdaAvg when supplied; otherwise analyst EBIT plus modeled D&A, explicitly derived. YTD operating EBITDA is reported operating EBIT plus cash-flow D&A, not an adjusted analyst measure.
provenance.depreciation: Analyst EBITDA minus EBIT when nonnegative and both available; otherwise modeled TTM D&A/revenue. Analyst measure definitions are not independently certified.
provenance.riskFreeRate: User-directed USD Treasury proxy under the HKD/USD peg; not an observed HKD yield or a copied US-stock WACC
provenance.tax: TTM effective tax; scenario assumption, not a marginal-rate forecast
provenance.kd: TTM accounting interest / average reported debt; not a current financing quote
provenance.erp: 4.75% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.beta: FMP profile beta; lookback, frequency and benchmark unspecified by the response
provenance.terminalG: 2.25% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.cash: All reported cash and short-term investments assumed nonoperating; adjustable
provenance.investments: Long-term investments assumed nonoperating at book value; adjustable, not fair-value evidence
provenance.priority: Preferred and minority book values are adjustable value proxies; cost defaults to common Ke
provenance.leases: Cash-flow-matched debt reconciliation: liabilities whose payments remain in FCFF are not deducted again; financing treatment requires matching profit, depreciation and reinvestment adjustments
